title: Affine comparison for affine transition limit
statement: For an affine transition limit cone whose stages are affine, the limit point is canonically isomorphic to the spectrum of the colimit of global sections, compatibly with projections.

proof.text: For affine stages, the spectrum of the filtered colimit of global sections is a limit by Stacks Limits Lemma 01YW.  Uniqueness of limit cones gives the displayed isomorphism and projection equations.

proof_origin: written from the Stacks Project proof
